connector.name: Eodly
connector.registryDescription: Read your team's end-of-day reports and roster from Eodly.
connector.summary: Hosted at eodly.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the adebayojuwon200-pixel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EODLY_API_KEY
env.description: An Eodly API key (eodly_sk_...). Create one in the Eodly app under Settings > Developer > API keys.
